request.goal: Make `safeWindowsFileName` handle every reserved Windows device name, including the numbered COM and LPT forms. Acceptance requires observing on Windows that the replacement name can actually be created; src/platform.test.ts already has that case. Implement it end to end.

plan.summary: Expand `safeWindowsFileName` to cover the full Windows reserved device-name set and prove the replacement is creatable on Windows.
plan.overview: Update the reserved-name matcher in `src/platform.ts` to every Windows device name (CON/PRN/AUX/NUL, COM0–COM9, LPT0–LPT9, and superscript COM/LPT forms), keep the `_` prefix replacement, expand focused unit coverage in `src/platform.test.ts`, and implement the existing win32-only create observation so it actually creates the replacement path on Windows.

features.title: Cover all reserved device names
features.summary: `safeWindowsFileName` renames every reserved Windows device name, including numbered COM/LPT and superscript forms, by prefixing `_`.
validation: Unit cases cover CON/PRN/AUX/NUL, COM0–COM9, LPT0–LPT9, and superscript COM/LPT forms with the `_` prefix replacement.

features.title: Windows replacement create check
features.summary: Implement the existing win32-only test so the replacement name from `safeWindowsFileName` can actually be created as a file on Windows.
validation: On win32, test "creates the replacement on Windows" creates a file using the safe replacement name and cleans up.

requirements: `safeWindowsFileName` treats every reserved Windows device name as unsafe: CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0–COM9, LPT0–LPT9, and superscript COM¹/COM²/COM³ and LPT¹/LPT²/LPT³ (case-insensitive exact basename).
Unsafe names are returned with a leading `_` so they are no longer reserved device names.
Focused unit tests document the full reserved set behavior.
Acceptance observation: on Windows, the replacement name can actually be created as a file; implement the existing skipped case in `src/platform.test.ts`.
Non-goal: broader path sanitization (invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, full path segments) beyond reserved device basenames.
decisions: Use the current Microsoft reserved device-name set including COM0/LPT0 and superscript digit forms, not only COM1–9/LPT1–9.
Keep the existing `_${name}` replacement strategy already used for `con`.
Windows file-create proof stays a `test.skipIf(process.platform !== "win32")` case so Linux CI skips cleanly while win32 must pass.
Gate command is `bun test` per README.

evidence.requirement: On Windows, the replacement name from safeWindowsFileName can actually be created as a file
